_comment: One file = provider + corpus config. Copy to config.json next to your documents and adjust. Provider keys: model/type/url/api_key/max_tokens/capabilities/thinking_effort/env/timeout. Corpus keys: dirs (input dirs, relative to THIS file), corpus_dir, index_dir. Engine tuning: mode/rrf_k/bm25_k/dense_k/final_k/path_boost/bm25_aux/embed_model/rerank/compile_workers/accept_legacy_models/llm_timeout/provider_wait_budget_s. Extra provider shards for multi-provider sharding go in 'providers'. With no --config flag, ./config.json in the CWD is used.
